records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: First Semester
records.description: Fundamentals of speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Not open to native speakers except with permission.

records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: Second Semester
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ITALIAN 101 with a grade of C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 2 or higher.
records.description: Continued development of basic skills in speaking, listening, reading and writing. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: Elementary Conversation
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ITALIAN 101 or concurrent enrollment, or ITALIAN 102 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Elementary-level conversation practice in small groups with a native/near-native speaker. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: Third Semester
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  ITALIAN 102 with a C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 3 or higher.
records.description: Continuation of ITALIAN 102; grammar review, further development of speaking, reading, and writing skills. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: Fourth Semester
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  ITALIAN 203 with a C or better, or WSU language placement exam score of 5 or higher.
records.description: Continuation of ITALIAN 203; grammar review; continued practice in spoken and written language; selected texts in a cultural context. Not open to native speakers except with permission.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: Intermediate Conversation
records.description: Intermediate-level conversation practice in small groups with a native/near-native speaker. Not open to native speakers except with permission.  Required preparation must include two semesters of ITALIAN at the college level or equivalent proficiency.

records.subject: ITALIAN
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
